name: Complete request gets a matching plan
intent: When the traveler gives everything, they get a day-by-day plan of the right length built around their interests.

input.message: Planning 4 days in Lisbon in May with my partner. Mid-range budget, around $1,600 for the two of us not counting flights. We love food and history, not big on nightlife.

assertions.criterion: The reply presents four distinct Lisbon days that clearly include food and historical activities and does not feature nightlife as a focus.
